author: Stoica-Mihai

name: quality-assurance
description: Quality-engineering skills — smoke testing, build-verification gates, regression discipline, and visual screenshot diffing. Includes the smoke-test skill that scaffolds a focused 5-10 check suite in the right framework (FastAPI/pytest, Express/Vitest, Go httptest, axum/tower), and compare-screenshots, which diffs two UI screenshots (any size/zoom) into a similarity score, a confidence-coloured annotated overlay, and a written rundown.
author: Stoica-Mihai

name: futurism-design
description: Futurism web design system — bold italic display, single red accent, square corners, solid offset shadows, fast directional motion, paired light/dark themes. A drop-in stylesheet + full component kit with an explicit skill that keeps generated UI on-brand.
author: Stoica-Mihai

name: adversarial-testing
description: Adversarial testing — inputs chosen to break a system rather than confirm it works. Routes by test-oracle class across three layers: classical software (metamorphic relations, differential testing, coverage-guided and stateful fuzzing, mutation testing), AI and language-model systems (prompt injection, multi-turn escalation, agentic tool abuse, attack-success-rate measurement), and the tools that automate both (PyRIT, garak, promptfoo, DeepEval, DeepTeam). Slash-command only — never auto-invoked.
author: Stoica-Mihai

name: divergence
description: Injects externally-generated entropy into creative work so output lands somewhere other than the model's default. Asking for something unconventional cannot escape the distribution — every framing has its own mode, and sampling parameters are removed on current models — so novelty has to be supplied from outside. Ships an OS-entropy seed drawer, hand-authored constraint decks across six domains, an accreting ledger of what past runs produced, and a falsifiable check that measures whether repeated runs on one brief actually landed apart.
author: Stoica-Mihai

name: reverse-engineering
description: Reverse-engineer a game or software backend from its compiled client and reconstruct an authoritative server emulator. Walks a seven-phase pipeline — client memory/netcode audit, engine decompilation (Unity IL2CPP/Mono, Unreal GObjects/GNames, Godot), crypto-handshake analysis (DH/DHE/ECDHE/RSA), protocol and serialization RE (TLV framing, Protobuf/FlatBuffers/gRPC/MessagePack), and high-concurrency emulator architecture — pairing every offensive finding with the server-side hardening that closes it. Bundles pure-stdlib triage scripts (payload identifier, raw-Protobuf decoder, TLV parser, IL2CPP metadata probe). Authorized-use scope: game preservation, security research on owned or in-scope software, interoperability, and CTF.
author: Stoica-Mihai
